{"source":"def investigate(context, acquire):
    actions = context.get("actions")
    if actions is None:
        actions = []
    rows = []
    seq = 0
    open_tx = False
    saved_rows = []
    saved_seq = 0
    for action in actions:
        op = action.get("op")
        if op == "put":
            ident = action.get("id")
            rows.append(ident)
            if ident > seq:
                seq = ident
        elif op == "delete":
            ident = action.get("id")
            if ident in rows:
                rows.remove(ident)
        elif op == "begin":
            open_tx = True
            saved_rows = list(rows)
            saved_seq = seq
        elif op == "commit":
            open_tx = False
            saved_rows = []
            saved_seq = seq
        elif op == "rollback":
            open_tx = False
            rows = saved_rows
            seq = saved_seq
            saved_rows = []
            saved_seq = 0
    return seq + 1
